    return closest_guy

modern_c1_yi.program:
def answer_query(image):
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    woman_patches = image_patch.find("woman")
    red_patches = image_patch.find("red")

    # Check if woman and red patches exist
    if not woman_patches or not red_patches:
        return "No woman or red object found in the image."

    # Find woman patches that overlap with red patches
    matching_patches = [woman for woman in woman_patches for red in red_patches if woman.overlaps_with(*red.coords)]

    if not matching_patches:
        return "No woman on red found in the image."

    # Sort patches by the distance to the top of the image and return the closest one
    matching_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: patch.upper)
    closest_patch = matching_patches[0]

    return f"The woman on red is located at coordinates ({closest_patch.left}, {closest_patch.lower}, {closest_patch.right}, {closest_patch.upper})."
